data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L1 ~ Ray of Enfeeblement
data.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
data.description: A coruscating ray springs from your hand. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to strike a target. The subject takes a penalty to Strength equal to 1d6+1 per two caster levels [maximum 1d6+5]. The subject's Strength score cannot drop below 1. A successful Fortitude save reduces this penalty by half. This penalty does not stack with itself. Apply the highest penalty instead.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
